business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Legacy intimate-apparel company (established 1991, Mumbai-headquartered) with a five-decade brand legacy across VIP, Frenchie, Frenchie X, Feelings and Leader, repositioning from traditional innerwear heritage into a broader lifestyle and apparel platform spanning innerwear, leisurewear, outerwear and adjacent categories for men, women and children.
- Strategy combines legacy brand strength with a renewed product, brand and channel approach, leveraging e-commerce, modern retail, D2C and its established pan-India distribution network for the next phase of growth.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body: - Proposed preferential issue of convertible warrants aggregating approximately ₹47.7 crore, intended to strengthen the financial platform, provide greater financial flexibility, strengthen working capital and support growth initiatives as the Company scales its product categories and distribution footprint.
